name: quicklaunch.io
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.
lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.
summary: quicklaunch.io scores 45 out of 100 (F). 15 checks fail now, 35 are at risk, and 31 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /identity-access/, /higher-education/solutions/identity-management/single-sign-on-sso/, /higher-education/solutions/identity-management/adaptive-multi-factor-authentication-mfa/ and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 14 elements on /, /identity-access/, /higher-education/solutions/identity-management/single-sign-on-sso/, for example .slider_prev and .slider_next. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: A cookie banner was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw HubSpot (2 requests).
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Tracking continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Decline All" and reloading, HubSpot (2 requests), and new cookies __hs_cookie_cat_pref still appeared.
fix.fix: Map every tag in the consent tool to a category and block it until that category is accepted.
